{{Recipe summary
| Category = Dumpling recipes
| Difficulty = 4
}}

{{recipe}}

'''Khanom Tian''' (ขนมเทียน) is a pyramid-shaped Chinese-Thai [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]], often served during festivals such as Sat Chin (Chinese Ghost Festival) and Chinese New Year. This dessert consists of a dough and a salty or sweet filling.

== Ingredients ==
__NOTOC__

=== Dough ===
* 100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Palm Sugar|palm sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
* 200 g [[Cookbook:Rice Flour|glutinous rice flour]]

=== Sweet filling ===
* 100 g [[Cookbook:Palm Sugar|palm sugar]]
* 2 cups overripe [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 6 large [[Cookbook:Banana leaf|banana leaves]]

==Procedure==

=== Dough ===
# Melt the palm sugar in a pan with coconut milk and cool to room temperature.
# Mix the glutinous rice flour with the coconut milk until a smooth and slightly sticky [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] is formed.
# Cover the dough and let sit for 3 hours or overnight.

=== Filling ===
# Combine the palm sugar and water in a pan, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] until dry enough.
# Add coconut, and simmer until it is sticky.
# Let it sit for 10–15 minutes.

=== Assembly ===
# Oil your hand. Roll a 3-cm chunk of dough into a ball, and flatten it into a circle.
# Place a ball of filling into the dough. Gently fold the dough around the filling, and pinch the seams shut.
# Place the dough balls into a greased dish to prevent sticking.
# Wash the banana leaves. Use scissors to cut the leaves into two rounded sizes—one should be 16–18 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] in diameter and the others 12–14 cm in diameter.
# Place a large leaf section and a small leaf section together with the dull sides facing each other. This doubles up the leaves and makes them stronger. Do this for all the leaves.
# Fold one end of the banana leaf into a cone, and drop in the stuffed dough ball.
# Fold over the shorter side of the cone.
# Fold over both sides of the banana leaf perpendicularly to the cone seam.
# Tuck the long tail into the little slot.
# Fold over the long tail that is left, and put it into the slot. Crease the folds of the pyramid a bit to strengthen it.

=== Cooking ===
# Place all of the dumplings in a single layer into a [[Cookbook:Steamer|steamer]]. [[Cookbook:Steaming|Steam]] for 20–30 minutes.
# Let the dumplings cool slightly before eating.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The video [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GmSMBZ5B9-E&t=262s here] provides a demonstration on how to shape the banana leaves during assembly.
